name: Rain
author: David JM
description: Background effects over the desktop wallpaper, behind your windows. Toggled from the bar: a GPU shader paints animated scenes on a full-screen background layer.

barWidget.description: A wand icon that paints animated effects over the desktop wallpaper, behind every window. Pick rain with lightning, snowfall, puddle ripples, floating dust, fireflies, falling leaves, aurora, embers, bubbles, confetti, caustics, or light shafts. Click to toggle; right-click for effect, intensity, speed, framerate, and resolution settings. Effects render on a background layer behind every window, so your apps stay on top.

schema.label: Effect running
schema.description: Whether the background effect is currently active. Clicking the wand toggles this value.

schema.label: Effect
schema.description: The background effect painted over the wallpaper.

schema.label: Leaf style
schema.description: Falling Leaves effect: the same tumbling leaves, recolored — autumn rust/gold, or cherry blossom white/pink.

schema.label: Light source corner
schema.description: Light Shafts effect: which corner the shafts stream from — top-left, top-right, bottom-left, or bottom-right.

schema.label: Straightness
schema.description: Light Shafts effect: how straight the beams are — 0 = wavering and curving, 1 = subtly bowed (default), 2 = ruler-straight.

schema.label: Intensity
schema.description: Continuous intensity, 1 = light to 3 = heavy. Meaning per effect: rain intensity, snow density, leaf count, firefly amount, aurora brightness, dust amount.

schema.label: Speed
schema.description: Continuous speed controlling the effect's motion, from 0.5 (slow) to 3 (fast).

schema.label: Framerate
schema.description: Frames per second the effect animates at. Lower = less GPU work, choppier motion. Applies to every effect.

schema.label: Resolution
schema.description: Render scale relative to native resolution: 0.5x = a quarter of the pixels (softer, far cheaper), 1x = native, 2x = supersampled. Very large windows are capped to protect the render budget. Applies to every effect.

schema.label: Lightning flashes
schema.description: Rain effect: random real lightning bolts (with a soft sky flash) drawn by the shader.

schema.label: Audio reactive (Aurora)
schema.description: Aurora effect: the curtain reacts to system audio, swells with the music and shimmers faster.
